7750.title: Warm timeline remount investigation
7750.rootCauseOneLine: Latency root cause remains unverified: keyed page remounts rerun scroll/window geometry and Markdown-table ancestor style reads, but the DOM-only probe cannot establish forced browser recalculation or its cost.
7750.proposedFix: Capture a real-browser trace of warm sidebar switches on trusted main, then identify read-after-write invalidation stacks before changing scroll anchoring, observer batching, or view lifetime.
7750.caveats: No Chrome/Chromium on the host; no browser CPU or style-recalculation measurement. The passing JSDOM diagnostic is not a latency regression test.
